newsitem.title: USA: Canadon Seco crude placed at $3.90-$4.00 off WTI. [CORRECTED 22:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Canadon Seco crude placed at $3.90-$4.00 off WTI. [CORRECTED 22:44 GMT]

text.p: Argentine YPF placed 950,000 barrels of Canadon Seco crude oil at $3.90 to $4.00 (corrects price from "$2.90 to $3.90") under October West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on an fob basis, trade sources said on Monday.
The cargo, which loads August 24-25, was sold to a major U.S. refiner.
Canadon Seco is a medium- to heavy-gravity crude with an API gravity of 25.7 degrees and 0.20 percent sulfur.
YPF, the former state oil company of Argentina, remains the country's top oil producer.
